**I’d hold the merge—one blocking issue.**

**[P1] Overlapping contacts aren’t deduped by ID** — `src/dedupe.js:2`  
`new Set(contacts)` compares object references, not contact IDs. Separate imports produce distinct objects, so the same contact survives twice. This violates the documented “one contact per id, keeping the first seen” behavior and affects `mergeImports` directly.

Reproduced with:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
// Actual: both contacts
// Expected: only the first contact
```

Track seen IDs while retaining the first object. Add regression tests using **different objects with the same ID**, both for `dedupe` and across lists in `mergeImports`; the existing duplicate test only repeats the same object reference.

Reviewed `main...dedupe-imports` at `62644c3`. All 4 existing tests pass, but both targeted overlap checks fail. No files changed.
